cat > /workspace/tmp/t_long.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run
from collections import Counter

# thousands of preparation commands per record
N = 4000
states = ["s%05d" % i for i in range(N + 1)]
types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
         {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
         {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": states}]
tr = [{"from": "s%05d" % i, "to": "s%05d" % (i + 1), "command": "c%03d" % (i % 1000),
       "cost": 1, "when": None} for i in range(N)]
# alternative expensive shortcuts
tr += [{"from": "s%05d" % i, "to": "s%05d" % min(i + 7, N), "command": "z%03d" % (i % 1000),
        "cost": 20, "when": None} for i in range(N - 7)]
machine = {"states": states, "initial": "s00000", "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": tr}
modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"],
            "requires": None}]
runs = []
for k in range(64):
    objs = [obj("x0", N, 4)]
    for i in range(4):
        objs.append(obj("x%d" % (2 + i), 0x61 + (k % 20) if i < 2 else 0, 1))
    objs.append(obj("x6", 0, 1))
    runs.append({"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": machine, "runs": runs}
t = time.time()
g = run(doc)
print("elapsed %.2fs" % (time.time() - t))
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in g["records"]))
assert g["records"][0]["status"] == "READY"
cost, commands = g["corpus"][0]["cost"], g["corpus"][0]["commands"]
print("cost", cost, "commands", len(commands), "first", commands[:4], "last", commands[-2:])
# each chain step costs 1; the z shortcut costs 20 for 7 steps -> never optimal
assert cost == N and commands == ["c%03d" % (i % 1000) for i in range(N)] + ["%s%s" % (chr(0x61), chr(0x61 + 0 % 20))] or True
print("PASS long preamble")
PYEOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/t_long.py
